zh: 速度为 d 时，每一堆需要 ceil(a/d) 个时间单位，而且这是独立的；总时间随速度增大而不增，可行性是单调的。
在 [1, max(a)] 上二分最小可行速度，判断条件是各堆 ceil(a/d) 之和不超过期限 h。速度再快每堆也至少占 1 个时间单位。
若 h<n 则不可行，输出 −1；否则 lo=1、hi=max(a)；取 mid，累加每堆的 (a+mid−1)/mid，若总和≤h 则 hi=mid，否则 lo=mid+1；h 可达 10^18，需用 64 位整数读取和比较。
en: At speed d each pile needs ceil(a/d) time units on its own, and the total time never increases as the speed grows, so feasibility is monotone.

Binary search the smallest feasible speed in [1, max(a)]; the test is whether the sum of ceil(a/d) over all piles is at most the deadline h. However fast you eat, each pile still takes at least one unit.

If h < n it is infeasible: print -1; otherwise set lo = 1 and hi = max(a); for mid, add (a + mid - 1) / mid over all piles; if the total is <= h set hi = mid, else lo = mid + 1. h can reach 10^18, so read and compare it as a 64-bit integer.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Binary search the speed, testing it with the sum of the time each pile needs, ceil(a/d).

## Proof of correctness

At a fixed speed each pile needs, and is satisfied by, ceil(a/d) exclusive time units. The total time is non-increasing in the speed, so binary searching for the first feasible speed is correct. Positive quantities make the minimum total time n, so there is no solution when h < n.

## Complexity

O(n log max(a)) time, O(n) input space.
